disc.name: Disc
disc.description: Reduces damage taken from collisions with mobs and flowers.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.description:
On death, summons a mob to fight again.
Mob type depends on where the sacrifice happens.
Cannot be used in low mob rarity areas.

ram.name: RAM
ram.description: Computer memory. It is expensive but it might have a secret use.

cursor.name: Cursor
cursor.description: A cursor that can be used to control pets of rarities lower than its own.

computer_chip.name: Computer Chip
computer_chip.description: Can be used to assemble more powerful petals.

champion_crown.name: Champion's Crown
champion_crown.description:
Gives flowers around you a {rarity} Basic.
You receive credit for damage dealt using it.

bandage.name: Bandage
bandage.description:
Turns the flower <c val="#83B05D">Undead</c> for a limited time on death.
Delays death until expiration.
Flower <c val="#FF6666">Body Damage</c> is reduced during this period.
Prevents revival for some time afterwards.
